'''Peer Macrobinoculars''', also known as '''snooper goggles''', were a series of handheld [[Macrobinoculars/Legends|macrobinoculars]] designed for civilian use and manufactured by [[VidGraph/Legends|VidGraph]]. The Peer was specialized for twilight and nighttime viewing, and, like all macrobinoculars, had an internal readout that showed information on distance and land elevation.<ref name="ROE" />
